name: Bellpuig (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a green mount of three peaks along the lower edge, surmounted by a green fleur-de-lis.
history: The official flag of Bellpuig is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, yellow, with the green three-peaked mount of the inescutcheon set along the lower edge, the central peak 37 per cent of the height and 39 per cent of the length of the cloth; approved on 5 July 1994 and published in the DOGC on 20 July 1994.

features.role: mount of three peaks along the lower edge
fleur-de-lis rising from the central peak
